title: forms simple vertical stack
rule: Forms stay a simple vertical stack. Do not rearrange controls with CSS (AT follows HTML order). Vertical is the layout for limited-vision left-to-right scanning.
pass_when: Controls follow source order in a vertical stack.
fail_when: CSS reorders fields away from HTML order, or a multi-column scramble that AT does not match.
overview: Forms stay a simple vertical stack that matches HTML source order for assistive tech.
apply_when: Laying out form controls for predictable left-to-right limited-vision scanning.
not_when: CSS reorders or multi-column scrambles that diverge from HTML order.
agent_hint: Keep form controls in a vertical source-order stack; do not CSS-reorder fields.
description: USWDS forms stay a simple vertical stack that matches HTML source order. Do not rearrange controls with CSS, because assistive technology follows HTML order, and vertical layout supports limited-vision left-to-right scanning. CSS reorders or multi-column scrambles that AT does not match fail the template and confuse keyboard order. Keep visual order aligned with source order in one vertical flow.
